claims.text: NPS provides a 19.186 second video of singing sand; its usage statement says NPS credited media without a copyright symbol are public domain.
Dry sand avalanching down a dune can produce a low sound; the page says the mechanism is not fully understood.
Women used detachable pockets tied around the waist; bags and pockets coexisted rather than following a simple replacement chronology.
Pineapples were once symbols of wealth displayed in grand houses.
Some firefly species flash in coordination with a larger group.
The page reports direct observations in December 2013 of thin floating ice panels driven by light winds pushing rocks across a shallow pond.
The Greenwich time ball was first used in 1833 to distribute a visible time signal to ships and Londoners.
